messages:
aj: Hey team — rolling FP8 to H100 canary showed a weird p95 tail-latency regression for long-context traffic (~+220ms). Throughput up ~6% but some requests hit a fallback path causing replays. nvprof shows mixed kernels triggered.

maria: Can you paste the profiler trace + runtime logs?

aj: pasted logs
```
[2026-03-15 10:12:03] KernelSelector: layer=12 seq=4096 selected=fused_gemm_int8 est_err=0.0032 < thresh=0.004
[2026-03-15 10:12:03] Runtime: fallback_to_fp32=False force_fp8=False chosen_kernel=fused_gemm_int8
[2026-03-15 10:12:04] KVCache: evicting 3 chunks due to max_chunks=1024 current=1027
[2026-03-15 10:12:04] Recompute: replaying tokens after eviction, replay_latency=180ms
```

aj: nvprof snippet:
```
Kernel time (ms): fused_gemm_fp8 12.3 | fused_gemm_int8 22.1 | kv_copy 3.2
Total per-step: 47ms -> 63ms when int8 chosen
```

kevin: interesting — scheduler heuristic uses calibration RMS to pick int8 vs fp8. For long contexts with KV copy + replay, int8's kernel path is heavier because of alignment/pad code; we saw similar on L40S but not H100 earlier.

maria: hypothesis: FP8 kernels have specialized fused KV path on H100 (tensor cores), but scheduler sometimes prefers INT8 when per-layer calibration_error < threshold; calibration numbers from offline run were noisy for layers > 10.

tori: can we force 'prefer_fp8_on_h100' flag in transformer_engine config for canary? Also increase kv_cache_max_chunks temporarily.

aj: created canary config:
```
transformer_engine:
  use_fp8: auto
  prefer_fp8_on_hardware: [H100]
  fp8_calib_mode: 'per_layer_smoothed'
kv_cache:
  max_chunks: 2048
  eviction_policy: lru_strict
```

benchbot: ran canary on p50 workload (seq=2048, bursty). Results: throughput +5.8%, p95 -30ms (improved), p99 -180ms (improved). But one sample still showed +240ms replay due to late eviction.

kevin: next step: smooth the calibration stats (EMA over N runs) and add jitter to kernel selection threshold to avoid flip-flops during traffic bursts.

maria: also add logging around kernel selection + kv eviction to capture correlation. If we can correlate 'kernel flip' events with eviction windows we'll confirm root cause.

runtime-bot: deploy canary config to target=canary-h100-rt group — started at 2026-03-15T10:45:00Z :rocket:

aj: thanks — follow-up: I'll add a micro-profiling hook to measure kernel latency + kv-copy overlap and post numbers tomorrow.
